integrity: The proof averages squared distances over each complete Hamming layer, reducing the full Euclidean optimization exactly to a one-variable maximum of two endpoint quadratics. This gives the center, radius, uniqueness, and contact classification symbolically. The source vertex description was inspected directly, and finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard 0/1-coordinate realization and ambient Euclidean metric. It determines the unique minimum enclosing sphere and contact set for every nonempty S, but not affine-invariant radii, inradii, extremal ellipsoids, or the full distance distribution. The ordinary singleton-layer hypersimplex case is elementary; the claimed contribution is the complete arbitrary-S endpoint-only classification.
title: Extreme cardinality layers determine the minimum enclosing sphere of every S-hypersimplex
